label: retailer sweep
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

reclassified.why: Last screenshot shows the PAGO section with card, Apple Pay, Klarna and PayPal to choose from; the oracle did not yet count a payment method choice.

findings.problem: The cookie dialog opened with focus on the privacy policy link, and the page behind it was still fully readable, so I could not tell the dialog was modal. The decline button was only found by jumping to it by name.
On first load the size area only said Loading product sizes, with no size choices and no status. I had to re-read the page to find that size OSFA was already chosen and available.

After pressing Añadir a la bolsa the button only changed to a disabled loading state. No confirmation was announced, focus dropped to the top of the page, and I only learned it worked because the bag link count changed from 0 to 1.

Every form field has a doubled accessible name, such as Nombre Nombre and Código postal Código postal. There are also many empty paragraphs and alerts, and the character counter alerts (Quedan N caracteres) are announced while typing.

The Continuar con el pago button stayed disabled with no explanation of which fields were missing. The Country dropdown offers only Spain, so the given US address had to go into a Spanish form with street name and street number as separate fields.

After activating Continuar con el pago the button said only cargando. The page changed in place to the payment step with no announcement or heading, and focus landed on the Aplica una tarjeta regalo button, so I could not tell the step had changed without re-reading the whole page.

findings.problem: The cookie dialog opened with focus on the privacy policy link, and the page behind it was still fully readable, so I could not tell the dialog was modal. The decline button was only found by jumping to it by name.
On first load the size area only said Loading product sizes, with no size choices and no status. I had to re-read the page to find that size OSFA was already chosen and available.

After pressing Añadir a la bolsa the button only changed to a disabled loading state. No confirmation was announced, focus dropped to the top of the page, and I only learned it worked because the bag link count changed from 0 to 1.

Every form field has a doubled accessible name, such as Nombre Nombre and Código postal Código postal. There are also many empty paragraphs and alerts, and the character counter alerts (Quedan N caracteres) are announced while typing.

The Continuar con el pago button stayed disabled with no explanation of which fields were missing. The Country dropdown offers only Spain, so the given US address had to go into a Spanish form with street name and street number as separate fields.

After activating Continuar con el pago the button said only cargando. The page changed in place to the payment step with no announcement or heading, and focus landed on the Aplica una tarjeta regalo button, so I could not tell the step had changed without re-reading the whole page.
